claim.statement: Cursor's rolling MCP documentation says configured MCP servers can expose external tools and data; tools may be disabled, Agent asks for approval before use by default, and Auto-run can allow MCP use without asking.

source.title: Cursor Model Context Protocol documentation
source.locator: Using MCP in chat, Toggling tools, Tool approval and Auto-run

values: local or remote Streamable HTTP MCP

limitations: The documentation describes configuration alternatives; it does not establish any installed MCP server, tool, credential or approval decision.
Auto-run and manual approval must remain separate applicability scopes.
unknowns: Configured MCP servers, exposed tools, arguments, credentials and data destinations are unknown.
Whether approval or Auto-run covered every MCP call and indirect side effect was not tested.
